This is not a great surprise. Harmine and harmaline are potent monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs), which have been known for quite some time to have anti-depressant effects by themselves, in addition to making the DMT actually work (otherwise it gets destroyed by the liver before it can do anything). Dietary restrictions are fairly important though, as MAOIs greatly increase the risk of serious problems from common food sources containing tyrosine and tyramine. This is a big part of why alpha-methyl tryptamine (AMT) as an antidepressant never took off in the west, despite having considerable uptake in Russia. AMT is also some weird shit, but not at the ~10mg daily doses used for anti-depression purposes.
